what-is-ai.title: AI is a family of ideas
what-is-ai.description: Four nested circles: artificial intelligence contains machine learning, which contains deep learning, which contains generative AI.

ai.name: Artificial intelligence
ai.text: Machines doing tasks that usually need human thinking

ml.name: Machine learning
ml.text: Learns patterns from examples, not fixed rules

dl.name: Deep learning
dl.text: Many stacked layers: a neural network

gen.name: Generative AI
gen.text: Creates new text, images and sound

generative-ai.title: Recognize or create
generative-ai.description: Left: classic AI looks at a cat photo and labels it cat, 98%. Right: generative AI turns the words a cat reading the newspaper into a brand new picture.
generative-ai.caption: It learned from millions of examples – now it makes new ones.

llm.title: A very well-read autocomplete
llm.description: The sentence The cat sat on the, with the likely next words: mat 62%, sofa 18%, floor 11%, moon 1%. The model picks mat, then repeats the process.
llm.again: …then it does it again, word after word.
llm.large: Large: trained on a huge library of text
llm.model: Language model: predicts what comes next

tokens.title: AI reads in chunks
tokens.description: The sentence Prompting is a skill you can learn is split into 9 tokens, for 35 characters. Tokens drive cost, speed and memory limits.
tokens.rule: In English, 1 token is about ¾ of a word

why.title: Why it matters
why.memory: Memory limits are measured in tokens

context-window.title: The context window
context-window.description: A conversation of eight messages. Only the last four fit inside the context window; the first four slide out of view and are forgotten.

messages.0: Hi. I need a slogan for our bakery.
messages.2: We bake everything at night, by hand.
messages.3: How about: Fresh by dawn, made by hand.
messages.4: Nice. Now a short social media post?
messages.5: Here's a draft with three hashtags…
messages.6: Make it a bit warmer, please.
messages.7: Done. Remind me – when do you bake?

context-window.caption: Everything the AI can see at once – measured in tokens.
context-window.tip: Long chat? Start fresh or recap the key points.

hallucinations.title: Confident is not correct
hallucinations.description: A user asks who won the 1987 Mars Marathon. The AI confidently gives a name and a time, but the race never existed. Stamp: plausible is not true. Checklist: ask for sources, check key facts, allow I don't know.
hallucinations.question: Who won the 1987 Mars Marathon?
hallucinations.answer: Elena Ruiz won it, in 3 hours 12 minutes.
hallucinations.tag: Sounds right… but that race never existed.

prompt.title: Anatomy of a good prompt
prompt.description: A prompt card built in four parts: role, task, context and format.

role.label: Role
role.text: You are a friendly customer support agent.

context.label: Context
context.text: Their order is 3 days late; we can offer free shipping.

prompt.cta: Build your own on the laptop.

multimodal.title: More than words
multimodal.description: Text, images and audio go into one AI model, which can answer with text, images or speech.
multimodal.caption: Multimodal: many kinds of input and output.

agents.title: The agent loop
agents.description: Around the goal book a meeting room for Friday, four steps in a loop: plan (check the calendar), act (search for free rooms), observe (room 3 is free), repeat (book it, then confirm).
agents.goal: Book a meeting room for Friday

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.text: Book it, then confirm with you

tools.title: Tools do the heavy lifting
tools.description: Asked for 18% of 2,340, the AI calls a calculator tool instead of guessing, gets 421.2 back and uses it in its answer.
tools.question: What's 18% of 2,340?

skills.title: Know-how on demand
skills.description: A shelf of skill cards: brand voice, weekly report, invoice check. When the task write this week's report arrives, only the weekly report card is pulled out.
skills.caption: A skill: instructions and files the AI loads only when needed.

mcp.title: One plug for every tool
mcp.description: Before: the AI app needs a different custom connector for each tool. With MCP: one standard plug connects it to Drive, Calendar, a CRM and a database.
mcp.before: Before: a custom connector for every tool
mcp.caption: An open standard to plug AI into tools and data – like USB-C.

ai-safety-at-work.title: The traffic light
ai-safety-at-work.description: Green: public information and your own drafts are fine. Orange: anonymize client and colleague details first. Red: never paste passwords, API keys or confidential client data. Always check the answer.

green.title: Green – fine to share
green.text: Public information, your own drafts and ideas

orange.title: Orange – anonymize first
orange.text: Client or colleague names, emails, figures

red.title: Red – never paste
red.text: Passwords, API keys, contracts, confidential client data

ai-safety-at-work.verify: Always check the answer before you use it – and follow your company's AI policy.
